item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 24/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon is affecting the coast of Guangdong gradually. It will be slightly cooler with a few rain patches over the region in the next couple of days. The monsoon is expected to moderate slightly towards the weekend. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach Guangdong during the weekend. Temperatures will drop appreciably over the region.

Temp range: 18 - 21 C
